title: Dido Language (DDO) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map ... - Ethnologue
text: Dido is an endangered indigenous language of the Russian Federation and Georgia. It belongs to the Nakh-Daghestanian language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people. It is taught as a subject of instruction in some schools.
